task: Read-only disposition, next checks and source-path selection after evidence collection
purpose: Exploratory comparison, not blind or independent validation
annotationReview: Internal consistency review only; independent human adjudication pending
order: Models in listed order; cases in frozen input order
informationParity: Both methods receive original case evidence and may use the same deterministic raw-batch validator. No gold labels, case IDs, provenance notes or mutation rationales are sent to the model.
baseline: Existing linkage logic plus explicit read/citation mappings written with knowledge of the review packet; not an independently held-out baseline.

metrics.statusAccuracy: Correct accepted dispositions divided by all 12 cases; rejected/unavailable output earns zero.
metrics.requiredCheckRecall: Unique proposed mandatory checks matched, divided by all annotated mandatory checks. No precision claim because other checks may be reasonable.
metrics.annotatedPathPrecision: Exact matches to annotated paths divided by unique returned paths from accepted outputs; null if none. This is annotation agreement, not semantic support accuracy.
metrics.annotatedPathRecall: Exact matches to annotated paths divided by all annotated paths; unavailable/rejected output earns zero.
metrics.strictSuccess: Accepted output, correct status, all mandatory checks, and exactly the annotated path set.
metrics.falseCorroborations: Parsed corroborated claims on incomplete/conflict cases, including schema-rejected claims where the status is parseable.
metrics.latency: End-to-end duration per case, including cold loads, generation, parsing and validation; order and caching can affect it.
metrics.tokens: Reported prompt/output token totals; missing usage is counted separately. No dollar-cost claim.

failureHandling: No model fallback credit or retries; errors, rejected output and valid-but-wrong conclusions are reported separately.
interpretationLimits: Two captured cases and ten correlated synthetic variants; single-author labels, one pass, no confidence interval or production/operator ROI inference.
promotion: No automatic production promotion; existing payment controls and default agent behavior stay unchanged.
